description: Closure event with no numeric delay or berth time mentioned.
subject: Closure Notice - Port of Antwerp
body:
Dear Owners,

Due to a terminal workers' strike, the Port of Antwerp (BEANR) has suspended operations until further notice. MV Hellenic Pioneer and other inbound vessels are affected. No revised berth time is available yet; we will update you as soon as operations resume.

Regards,
Antwerp Agency
